title: Confirmed! BTS To Make Comeback In March 2026, Mega Announcement Leaves ARMYs Excited | Korean News - News18
text: It’s official! The globally popular K-pop group BTS is all set for a mega comeback on March 20, 2026. They will be releasing their first full-length album. This will mark the group’s first work approximately three years and nine months after the release of their anthology album ‘Proof’ in June 2022. Recently, BTS members confirmed their comeback date as they sent handwritten notes to their fans on the occasion of the New Year. While expressing gratitude, they also confirmed that they will make a mega comeback in March this year. In his message, group leader RM wrote, “We’ve waited more earnestly than anyone else" “Thank you so much for waiting," added Jin. While Suga wrote, “Let’s have fun together this year too. I love you", J-Hope also stated, “What I thought has finally become reality!" Teasing their comeback, Jimin added, “The year we meet has come." “Please look forward to it, because we’ll make even more good memories in 2026!" wrote V. “We miss you! Please take care of us this year too," Jungkook concluded. After the release of their album, BTS will also prepare for a world tour. According to South Korean media outlet Naver, the tour could run from May to December 2026, featuring nearly 65 shows worldwide and drawing close to four million fans. Reports suggest that individual concerts could host over 60,000 attendees each. Previously, J-Hope also appeared on MBC’s variety show Point of Omniscient Interfere (also known as The Manager), when he talked about BTS’ plans and the emotional impact of their reunion. “When I was discharged, I had mixed feelings. Now that all the members are finishing, I wonder if we’ll still have the same chemistry when we work together again. I feel both anxious and excited," J-Hope said. BTS, created by BigHit Entertainment in 2013, has risen to become one of the world’s most prominent musical acts, renowned for their dynamic performances, profound lyrics, and groundbreaking achievements.
